name: easyserp
description: Search Google and Bing from MCP clients with source filtering and safe recovery.
long_description: EasySERP provides Google and Bing search through an MCP server. Search requests use a private API key, preserve request receipts for recovery, and return real search titles, snippets, and links. Domain filters are applied to returned URLs. A normal successful search is submitted once.

tools.name: easyserp_search
tools.description: Search Google or Bing with bounded retries and optional source-domain filters.

tools.name: easyserp_batch_search
tools.description: Search several queries with bounded concurrency and ordered partial results.

tools.name: easyserp_request
tools.description: Read a known search request receipt without submitting a new search.

tools.name: easyserp_capabilities
tools.description: Show engines, setup, and pricing without an API key or search request.

api_key.title: EasySERP API key
api_key.description: Paste your EasySERP key from https://serp.skyvora.cc. Stored as a masked secret and passed only to this local server process.
